messages.text: Will a power spike fry the whole miner?

Great question — this is actually one of the Rev 6.1's real design wins.

**There's an onboard F1 fuse built right into the board**, sitting next to the yellow XT30 power input. If a spike hits:

- The F1 fuse blows first — it's a sacrificial automotive-style blade fuse
- The electronics behind it are protected
- You replace a cheap fuse, not the whole miner

Cheaper units skip this entirely — a spike goes straight through and can cook the board or kill the power supply along with it.

**Also worth noting:** the XT30 connector itself (rated 15 A) replaced the old Rev 5 barrel jack that was only rated 8 A and would sag and melt under load. The power path is just fundamentally beefier on this revision.

So — not bulletproof, nothing is — but a spike hits the $0.50 fuse, not your miner. 👍
